summary: Frontend-only regression for referral/landing-page bug fixes on SPILOVEURE. Exhaustively tested (1) referral redirect from /register?ref=admin to landing then to register with sponsor locked; (2) flag-independence of that behaviour; (3) direct visits with landing_page OFF and ON; (4) FR/EN size parity of hero title and tagline at desktop/tablet/mobile viewports; (5) /u/admin regression. All 7 acceptance criteria pass. Landing flag restored to OFF at end of testing.

test_results.referral_flag_on: PASS — /register?ref=admin → /?ref=admin (Landing rendered with SPILOVEURE hero + landing-register-btn). CTA → /register?via=landing&ref=admin. register-sponsor value='admin', editable=false (fill blocked with TimeoutError), lock hint text = '🔒 Code parrain verrouillé (transmis via votre lien d'invitation : @admin).'
test_results.referral_flag_off: PASS — /register?ref=admin still redirects to /?ref=admin and Landing renders (feature-flag independent for referral visitors).
test_results.direct_flag_on: PASS — / with landing_page=true shows Landing, CTA → /register?via=landing (no ref), register-sponsor empty.
test_results.u_admin_regression: PASS — /u/admin → /?ref=admin → Landing → CTA → /register?via=landing&ref=admin with sponsor='admin' locked.
test_results.no_redirect_loop: PASS — via=landing marker prevents re-bounce; user stayed on register page in both T1 and T5.

fr_en_size_parity.desktop_1440: hero title FR=60px EN=60px, tagline FR=18px EN=18px — MATCH
fr_en_size_parity.tablet_768: hero title FR=48px EN=48px, tagline FR=18px EN=18px — MATCH (previously 24px in FR — fixed)
fr_en_size_parity.mobile_390: hero title FR=36px EN=36px, tagline FR=16px EN=16px — MATCH

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): console warnings from RN-web — 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Pre-existing, not introduced by this fix.

register.tsx sponsor field: value is bound to `sponsorValid ? sponsor : ''`. If the async /sponsor/<ref> validation call ever fails transiently for a valid ref, the user will see an empty locked field with the generic invalid-link warning. Consider retry/backoff for network errors before deciding sponsorValid=false. Not blocking current fix.

context_for_next_testing_agent: landing_page flag has been RESTORED to false at end of run. Language toggle key in web is localStorage 'spiloveure.lang' with raw value 'fr' or 'en' (NOT JSON-encoded, contrary to the request note). To measure the hero SPILOVEURE title font-size, query ALL 'text=SPILOVEURE' matches and pick the largest — the header navbar also contains the SPILOVEURE brand at 20px.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (referral redirect): register.tsx effect now bounces to /?ref=… whenever ref is present and via!=landing, regardless of landing_page flag; index.tsx renders LandingPage whenever refCode is present OR landing_page flag is ON. The via=landing marker prevents redirect loops. Bug 2 (FR tagline oversized): LandingPage.tsx heroTagline was overridden inline to fontSize:24 on tablet — reduced to 18 to match EN. Verified computed styles are now identical across FR and EN in all three viewports.
